description: Revoke one client's authorization from a deployment's Tor v3 restricted discovery. The client loses access to the hidden service; the deployment, the .onion address and every other client are untouched. The name can be authorized again later with a fresh keypair. Requires an agent supporting onion-auth-v1.

deployment_id.description: The dpl_... id of the restricted onion deployment.

name: impreza_onion_auth_revoke
